lines.en: My ankle joint grinds against the gravel.
My kneecaps clatter against each other.
I still grip an iron pick.
woods... I can't go back.

lines.zh: 枕木烂了，我还认得方向。
lines.en: The sleepers have rotted, but I know the way.

lines.zh: 我沿矿车轨道一步步挪。
lines.en: I shuffle along the minecart rails.
The cave moss has dried to dust.
Only the dripping water answers.
Coal dust is packed in my joints.

lines.zh: 这条岔道，好像走过两遍。
lines.en: I think I've taken this fork twice.
Underground daytime is nothing I want to see.
At the tunnel's end, there's torchlight.
A miner's lamp hangs from my bones.
No need to breathe in the mines.

lines.zh: 我挖的坑道，现在拐错了弯。
lines.en: The tunnel I dug now turns wrong.

lines.zh: 矿道里，只有我的骨头在响。
lines.en: In this shaft, only my bones make sound.

lines.zh: 矿灯还亮着，人却不在了。
lines.en: The mine lamp still burns; its owner is gone.
My pick handle rotted long ago.

lines.zh: 靠着矿柱站到天荒也行。
lines.en: I can stand by this beam till the world ends.
No daylight in a shaft.

lines.zh: 左边少两根，右边少一根。
lines.en: Two missing on the left, one on the right.
I lean on a support post, losing track of years.

lines.zh: 你的火把，让我看得清你。
lines.en: Your torch lets me see you clearly.
Sweat, iron, and bread.

lines.zh: 火光把你的影子投在矿壁上。
lines.en: The torch throws your shadow on the tunnel wall.

lines.zh: 我的指骨碰了碰你的袖子。
lines.en: My finger bones brush your sleeve.
No — it's another skeleton.
Your eyes are cleaner than mine.

lines.zh: 矿洞底下，你认识这具骨架吗。
lines.en: Down in the mine, do you know these bones?
A living one. Still warm.
They call me Miner Skeleton. Remember.
The tunnel's caved in ahead; you don't know.

lines.zh: 发光浆果在兜里，还亮着。
lines.en: Glow berries in my pocket still shine.

lines.zh: 我的锁子甲早就锈穿了。
lines.en: My mail rusted through long ago.
Back off; my pick is still raised.
I haven't found that companion yet.
There's a nick in your blade.
Now there's only a dull thud.

lines.zh: 矿洞里挨了一下，还会疼。
lines.en: A hit in the mines — and I still feel it.
My jaw has come unhinged.
Bones don't bleed; they only crack.

lines.zh: 肋条断了一根，问题不大。
lines.en: One rib cracked; not a problem.

lines.zh: 矿灯下那点金，晃得我眼热。
lines.en: Gold in the miner's light makes my eyes burn.

lines.zh: 我记不起吃饱是什么感觉。
lines.en: I can't recall what full feels like.
I have no teeth, only a jawbone.
One bite of meat, just one.

lines.zh: 矿洞里的我，镐还挂在腰间。
lines.en: In the mine, my pick still hangs at my waist.
Don't throw away the bone you've gnawed.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的骨粉，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the bonemeal at your belt.
The cut on your hand is still seeping.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，熏得我发慌。
lines.en: Your body heat makes me restless.

lines.zh: 把那块干肉放在枕木上。
lines.en: Set that dried meat on the sleeper.
Dust from the roof hit my chest.
My pick lies deep in the shaft.
Sorry. Should I say that?
My collarbone drops at your feet.
I can't bend down; pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 你的热气烤着我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your warmth bakes my ribs.
My skull tilts to one side.

lines.zh: 我的镐还握在手里，锈了。
lines.en: My pick's still in my hand, rusted.
Living bone is this solid.
These tunnels are narrow — don't crowd them.

lines.zh: 洞里看不见月亮，就作罢。
lines.en: No moon down here, so never mind.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨头，抱一下就散了。
lines.en: One embrace would scatter these bones.

lines.zh: 矿道尽头，我挖了三十年。
lines.en: I dug the tunnel's end for thirty years.

lines.zh: 矿灯灭了，我的骨头还在走。
lines.en: The lamp is out; my bones still walk.
In the mine, I leave you the lamp.

lines.zh: 我连自己的坑都懒得挖。
lines.en: I can't even be bothered to dig my own.

lines.zh: 这具骨头，等不了那么久。
lines.en: These bones can't wait that long.
No wind in the tunnel, only damp.
The other half caved in from water.
I don't even have a heart anymore.
Dug out of the dirt, still fresh.
The arrowheads might fetch a coin.
My knuckles clatter as I hold it.
I tuck the iron ingot between my ribs.
A glow berry rolls into a crack.
A miner's tool, still usable.
I touched this gold ingot first.
A rusty pick I can't grip.
A few berries are left in my pocket.

lines.zh: 矿道里的发光浆果，我摘过。
lines.en: I've picked glow berries in these shafts.
None of the miners here got out.
I have all the time there is.
My bony hand draws the string past my jaw.

lines.zh: 洞里的蝙蝠都被你惊了。
lines.en: You've startled the cave bats.
This skeleton lacks a companion.

lines.zh: 你的靴底沾着洞外的泥。
lines.en: There's outside mud on your soles.

lines.zh: 还有一截没烧完的引线。
lines.en: And a half-burnt fuse, too.

lines.zh: 我兜里还揣着发光浆果。
lines.en: I still carry glow berries in my ribs.
My arrow is faster than your legs.

lines.zh: 这条矿道，我挖了一半就死了。
lines.en: I died halfway through digging this shaft.

lines.zh: 我在这条矿道守了很多年。
lines.en: I've kept this tunnel for many years.
I don't sleep, and I don't eat.
Let me see your frame.

lines.zh: 我的眼眶里，只剩一点光。
lines.en: Only a speck of light remains in my sockets.
I know these mine shafts well.

lines.zh: 你踩着的，是我挖的矿道。
lines.en: You're standing in the tunnel I dug.
Mine bones carry iron rust.
End of the shaft. Bow raised.
I have no leg muscle to tire.

lines.zh: 火把在你手里抖得厉害。
lines.en: That torch is trembling badly in your hand.
Footsteps carry far in here.
Wait for me, just a moment.

lines.zh: 矿道里的发光浆果，是我种的。
lines.en: The glow berries in this shaft are mine.
Pant away, there is no cover in the shaft.

lines.zh: 快了，矿道尽头就差一点。
lines.en: Almost, just short of the tunnel's end.
My pick is still on my shoulder.
My arrowhead stays on your back.

lines.zh: 我手里还握着那把铁镐。
lines.en: I still grip that iron pick.
At the mineshaft's end, you cannot run.
You cracked a shale slab.

lines.zh: 矿道我比你熟，退路早没了。
lines.en: I know these shafts; your way out is gone.
I know which rocks are loose.
I don't even need a lamp.
A click — pickaxe or bone?
That arrow missed by an inch.

lines.zh: 我的指节擦过你的下巴。
lines.en: My knuckles graze your chin.

lines.zh: 回声会在矿道里转很久。
lines.en: The echo will circle these tunnels.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，比我的骨头硬。
lines.en: Your armor is harder than my bones.
I swing wide and hit the support post.
I swing my whole arm.
I saw your knee buckle.

lines.zh: 发光浆果，我挖到过几颗。
lines.en: I've dug up a few glow berries.

lines.zh: 发光浆果，是我唯一的口粮。
lines.en: Glow berries are all I eat.

lines.zh: 一根骨头，也能敲碎指节。
lines.en: Even one bone can crack a knuckle.

lines.zh: 挥完这一下，手臂就脱臼。
lines.en: After this swing, my arm dislocates.
My shoulder joint sticks, then gives.

lines.zh: 发光浆果的光，把你的影子照出来了。
lines.en: Glow berries lit up your shadow.

lines.zh: 我的拳头就是几根指骨。
lines.en: My fist is just a few finger bones.
I need to reach that torchlight.
woods... back again.
I remember the light up there.
My spine clicks back into line.
The mine lamp is out; the night is long.
Old bones are pressed under the sleepers.
But I have no stomach to hunger with.

lines.zh: 我从矿道里出来，还带着煤灰。
lines.en: I come out of the mineshaft still dusted with coal.
I crawl up from deep in the shaft.

lines.zh: 矿井里，我的镐早就锈了。
lines.en: In the mine, my pick rusted long ago.
I can't get used to torchlight.

lines.zh: 矿道塌了这么久，谁把我叫醒。
lines.en: The shaft fell in long ago, who woke me?

lines.zh: 我从塌方的矿道里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of the caved-in shaft.

lines.zh: 指骨捡回来了，还差两根。
lines.en: My finger bones are back, two still missing.

lines.zh: 矿道塌了半截，我认得出来。
lines.en: Half the shaft caved in. I still know it.

lines.zh: 火舌一舔，我的指骨发黑。
lines.en: One lick of flame blackens my finger bones.
At the mine's bottom, my bones clatter.
The floodwater rises past my pelvis.
Shrapnel passes through my ribcage.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder blade.
Magic punched through my bones.

lines.zh: 骨头快撑不住这身皮了。
lines.en: The bones barely hold this skin.

lines.zh: 雷顺着矿车轨道劈下来。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the minecart rails.

lines.zh: 我脚下是矿道，不是深渊。
lines.en: Below me is a mineshaft, not an abyss.
